_comment: Mutation testing. Line coverage says a line ran; this says a test would have failed had the line been wrong. Not a pull-request gate: a full run takes minutes, so it runs on a schedule and on demand.
_ignoreComment: dist is excluded so the sandbox has no build output, which keeps test/gates.test.ts skipped (describe.skipIf(!isBuilt)) during the sweep. Those 17 tests each spawn a subprocess; running them once per mutant would take the run from seconds to hours.
